instance.emailCodeLoginEnabled: Allow passwordless sign-in with an email code
instance.emailCodeLoginEnabledHint: Off by default. Guests can request a six-digit code by email. The code alone records amr otp and never counts as MFA by itself.

webhooks.urlDescription: Exact URL Signaculum will POST to. Private and loopback hosts are refused unless the setting above is on.

form.editDescription: Update the OIDC client name, redirect URIs and flags.
form.createDescription: Register an OIDC client for a relying party. The client secret is generated for confidential apps.
form.redirectUrisHint: One absolute URL per line. https required except http://localhost or http://127.0.0.1. No fragments. Exact match at runtime.
form.confidentialHint: Uses a client secret at the token endpoint. Turn off for public SPAs.
form.firstPartyHint: Skips the consent screen for signed-in users.
form.clientCredentialsHint: Machine-to-machine access token without a user. Use for jobs, MCP agents and services — not for browser SSO.
form.deviceAuthorizationHint: RFC 8628 device flow for CLI, TV and IoT clients. Users enter a code at /oauth/device.
form.pushedAuthorizationHint: The application must send every sign-in request to the PAR endpoint first. Plain authorization links from it are refused. Turn on only when the application supports PAR.
form.frontchannelLogoutUriHint: Absolute https URL loaded in a hidden iframe on logout (OIDC Front-Channel Logout). Leave empty to skip. Exact value; no fragment.
form.frontchannelLogoutSessionRequired: Require iss and sid on front-channel logout
form.frontchannelLogoutSessionRequiredHint: When enabled, Signaculum appends issuer and session id query parameters to the logout URI.

settings.requireMfaRevokesTokens: Turning this on revokes every member's access and refresh tokens and signs them out of connected apps that support back-channel logout. Front-channel logout cannot run without each member's browser, so apps without a back-channel logout URI keep their own session until it expires. Members must sign in again with a second factor.
